p.all:
Order

Order Header

The Order Header Tab defines the parameters of an Order. Changing the Organization, Business Partner, Warehouse, Date Promised, etc. changes these values on all the lines.

Sales Order

Before you start. These must exist first: Target Document Type (Document Type), Business Partner, Partner Location (Business Partner), Warehouse (Warehouse and Locators), Price List, Sales Representative (User), Payment Term.

Do it. Fill Order, then Order Line, Order Tax, Payment Schedule, POS Payment; then the Document Action Complete.

What Complete does.

On Credit Order, Warehouse Order, POS Order (Prepay Order if Generate Shipment): also creates and completes the shipment ✓
POS Order, On Credit Order (Prepay Order if Generate Invoice): also creates the invoice ✓
Standard Order: reserves the ordered quantity; shipment and invoice are made next ✓
Quotation: reserves the quantity and creates nothing else
Proposal: reserves nothing and creates nothing else
Prepay Order: waits for a payment (status Waiting Payment)
The next action offered is Close

When it refuses, legacy says: “Period Closed” ✓; “Product is not on Price List” ✓; “Business Partner with this Order over Credit Hold” ✓; “Fill mandatory fields: Shipper”; “No Document Lines found”; “Product … Exclude Auto Delivery”; “Line No … - Invalid: Date Promised”; “Cannot change Document Type”; “Cannot reserve Stock”; “Error calculating tax”; “Error in payment schedule”.

Read from iDempiere's MOrder.java and the dictionary. ✓ = seen in a legacy run of 2026-11-23.

p.all:
Purchase Order

Order Header

The Order Header Tab defines the parameters of an order. The field values defined will determine how the Order Lines are processed.

Purchase Order

Before you start. These must exist first: Target Document Type (Document Type), Business Partner, Partner Location (Business Partner), Warehouse (Warehouse and Locators), Price List, Company Agent (User), Payment Term.

Do it. Fill Purchase Order, then PO Line, Order Tax, Payment Schedule, Estimated Landed Cost; then the Document Action Complete.

What Complete does.

On Credit Order, Warehouse Order, POS Order (Prepay Order if Generate Shipment): also creates and completes the shipment
POS Order, On Credit Order (Prepay Order if Generate Invoice): also creates the invoice
Purchase Order with no SO Sub Type: adds the ordered quantity to the warehouse's ordered stock; receipt and invoice are made next ✓
The next action offered is Close

When it refuses, legacy says: “Period Closed” ✓; “Product is not on Price List” ✓; “Business Partner with this Order over Credit Hold” ✓; “Fill mandatory fields: Shipper”; “No Document Lines found”; “Product … Exclude Auto Delivery”; “Line No … - Invalid: Date Promised”; “Cannot change Document Type”; “Cannot reserve Stock”; “Error calculating tax”; “Error in payment schedule”.

p.all:
Business Partner

Business Partner

The Business Partner Tab defines any Entity with whom an organization transacts.

Business Partner

Before you start. These must exist first: Business Partner Group.

Needed by. Each of these asks for one on its header: Sales Order, Purchase Order, Shipment (Customer), Payment and Receipt, Purchase Invoice and Credit/Debit Note, Material Receipt, Sales Invoice and Credit/Debit Note, Bank/Cash Transfer.

Do it. Fill Business Partner, then Contact (User), Location, Bank Account, Shipping Accounts, Customer Accounting, Vendor Accounting.

Read from the dictionary.

Step 4 · Create a customer

Open Business Partner (window 123) and click New record on the toolbar.
Organization: pick your company's HQ, or * to share the record across organizations.
Search Key: e.g. C-001. Name: e.g. Acme Retail Sdn Bhd.
Business Partner Group: pick Standard, the group the setup created for your company.
Tick Customer and click Save on the toolbar.

p.all:
Shipment

Shipments and Customer Returns

The Shipments Tab allows you to generate, maintain, enter and process Shipments to a Customer or Returns from a Customer.

Shipment (Customer)

Before you start. These must exist first: Business Partner, Partner Location (Business Partner).

Do it. Fill Shipment, then Shipment Line, Packages; then the Document Action Complete.

What Complete does.

Pick/QA Confirmation: Yes: creates a pick/QA confirmation document with one line per shipment line
Ship/Receipt Confirmation: Yes: creates a ship/receipt confirmation (after the pick/QA one when both are on)
Stays In Progress while a non-customer confirmation is unprocessed
Movement Type Customer Shipment, Vendor Returns: takes the line quantity out of the locator's on-hand stock (stocked products)
Movement Type Customer Returns, Vendor Receipts: adds the line quantity to the locator's on-hand stock (stocked products)
Reduces the product's reserved stock for the order line's warehouse ✓
Raises order line delivered qty on shipment (C-), lowers it on customer return (C+) ✓
Offers Close as the next document action

When it refuses, legacy says: “Either Order or RMA can be process on this document.”; “Period Closed”; “Back-Date transaction not allowed”; “No Document Lines found”; “Attribute Set Mandatory (Line No #… , Product=… )”; “Open: Ship/Receipt Confirmation”; “Insufficient Stock Coverage. A shipment should not be allowed if there is insufficient stock before the shipment’s movement date.”; “More than line qty on attribute tab for line …”; “Cannot correct Inventory OnHand (MA) [… ] - …”; and 9 more in MInOut.java.
